sentences.span: The big structural story remains intact: central banks are buying at more than 5x the pre-2022 pace.
sentences.why: The '5x pre-2022 pace' statistic is Goldman's (GIR) own line in 17230, not Societe Generale's. Societe Generale's deck (17214) does chart a Russia-reserves-freeze annotation ('On 28 Feb 2022, U.S. Treasury assets held by the Central Bank of Russia were frozen') on a central-bank gold-buying chart captioned 'structurally elevated,' which supports the causal-tracing half of the sentence, but no '5x'/pre-2022-pace multiplier appears anywhere in the SocGen text. The sentence attributes Goldman's statistic to Societe Generale as if it were SocGen's own finding -- a who-said-it distortion.
